message.content:
Let \(u = -3\cdot\text{atan}(3x)\) and \(dv = dx\). Then

\[
du = -\frac{9}{1+9x^2}\,dx,\qquad v = x
\]

Using integration by parts:

\[
\int -3\cdot\text{atan}(3x)\,dx
= -3x\cdot\text{atan}(3x) + 9\int \frac{x}{1+9x^2}\,dx
\]

Since

\[
\int \frac{x}{1+9x^2}\,dx = \frac{1}{18}\ln(1+9x^2),
\]

we get

\[
-3x\cdot\text{atan}(3x) + 9\cdot\frac{1}{18}\ln(1+9x^2) + C
\]

\[
= -3x\cdot\text{atan}(3x) + \frac{1}{2}\ln(1+9x^2) + C
\]

<answer>
-3*x*atan(3*x) + 1/2*ln(1+9*x**2) + C
</answer>
